result.brief: 提出"nuisance orthogonality"指标，量化图像/视频骨干表征先验的几何结构如何预测世界动作模型训练后的策略泛化与鲁棒性。
result.reason: Analyzes how representational priors from image/video backbones shape world action model generalization, quantifying nuisance orthogonality of inherited features—direct evidence for visual/video representation learning.
